subject: Summer Internship 2027 – Backend Engineering Intern
text:
Hi,

We are hiring backend interns for a 10-week summer internship with a monthly stipend. You will work with Python and FastAPI on our payments platform.

The last date to apply is 20 October 2026. Please reply with your resume.

Thanks,
Priya
